timeline.title: PSU banks extend November rally
timeline.line: Bank of India rises 4.31%; Bank of Baroda and Bank of Maharashtra gain 1.82% each
more: Union Bank rose 1.77%, PNB 0.94%, Canara Bank 0.88% and SBI 0.51%
Some heavyweight private lenders are trading lower
SBI, PNB, Canara, BoB and BoM had rallied over 20% in November by 20 Nov

src.title: Banking sector stocks today, November 27: Dhanlaxmi Bank gains 4.71%, Bank of India jumps 4.31%, IDFC First Bank up 2.41%
